name: babysitter
description: Watches your background agents, corrects the ones that loop, stall or error out, and reports when they are done.

mode.title: Intervention mode
mode.description: correct: write a fix into the agent, then kill and respawn it if it stays stuck. kill: stop at once. nudge: write a fix only. warn: only flag it.

maxRetries.title: Respawns per task
maxRetries.description: How many times a stopped task is respawned with a corrected prompt.

loopRepeats.title: Loop: identical failing calls
loopRepeats.description: Identical failing tool calls (in the last 8) that count as a loop.

errorStreak.title: Error streak
errorStreak.description: Tool errors in a row that count as stuck.

stallSeconds.title: Stall after (s)
stallSeconds.description: Seconds with no tool activity before an agent counts as stalled.

runawayMinutes.title: Runaway after (min)
runawayMinutes.description: Minutes an agent may run before it counts as runaway.

runawayCalls.title: Runaway after (calls)
runawayCalls.description: Tool calls an agent may make before it counts as runaway.

tokenBudget.title: Token budget per agent
tokenBudget.description: Tokens an agent may process (input, cache and output) before it counts as over budget. 0 turns it off.

useHaiku.title: Diagnose with Haiku
useHaiku.description: Ask Haiku to diagnose a stuck agent and to summarise the report.

judge.title: Judge before acting
judge.description: Before stepping in, ask Haiku whether the flagged agent is really stuck (VERDICT: NO_PROGRESS) or still progressing.

push.title: Push the report
push.description: Send the final report line as a push notification when you are away.
